trace.name: TAPP inguinal hernia repair: clean, mesh without fixation

case.note: Standard anatomy, indirect defect, not large medial. The reference performance: peritoneal flap incised 4 cm above the deep ring, MPO surveyed, Retzius and Bogros developed, sac reduced, the triangle of doom delimited with the external iliac vessels identified and no corona vessel found, the triangle of pain delimited without dissecting its nerves, the cord parietalized until the vas crosses the external iliac vein, pause taken, sac divided, mesh positioned over the whole orifice, fixation withheld - the defect is not a large medial (M3) defect, so non-fixation is the guideline default (T36, T38) - flap closed by suture and closure completeness confirmed. No prophylaxis is given - it is never recommended in laparo-endoscopic repair (T36, T37), so the process component reads 4/5 by design.
